full_judgment:
This Rule at the instance of 3rd party petitioner is against order dated 18-11-93 passed by the Senior Assistant Judge, Mymensingh, sadar in SCC Execution Case No. 2 of 1985 rejecting petitioner's prayer for staying further proceeding of the said Execution Case. 

 2. Opposite Party No. 1 as plaintiff filed SCC Suit No. 7 of 1983 in the said court against the predecessor-in-interest of opposite party Nos. 2(Ka) to 2(Chha) for his ejectment as monthly tenant on the ground of default in payment of rent. The suit was decreed ex parte on 22-4-85. Thereafter, opposite party No.1 started SCC Execution Case No. 2 of 1985 for taking delivery of possession. The petitioner claiming the suit property as vested property filed Misc. Case No. 11 of 1993 and also OC Suit No. 21 of 1983 renumbered as OC Suit No. 155 of 1990 and that suit has been stayed in Civil Revision No. 822 of 1991. Court below stayed further proceeding of the said execution case till disposal of the said Civil Revision on No. 822 of 1991 and other proceedings by order dated 24-2-93. Against the said order opposite party No. 1 filed Civil Revision No. 2584 of 1993 and obtained the order of stay. As a result court below proceeded with the said execution case. Thereafter, petitioner filed a fresh application for staying further proceeding of the said execution case. By the impugned order that prayer was rejected. Being aggrieved by the same petitioner moved this Court and obtained the present Rule. 

 3. Mr. Shahidul Alam Chowdhury, learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner, submitted that though the petitioner is a third party in the execution case as the Custodian to the Vested Property he has right to pray for stay of the execution case and court below acted illegally in refusing the said stay. 

 4. Mr. SK Sinha, the learned Advocate appearing for the opposite party No. 1, submitted that in spite of the order of stay passed by this Court in Civil Revision Case No. 2584 of 1993 Court below did not proceed with the said execution Case. So his client was compelled to file a contempt petition before this Court and in Civil Rule No. 242 (con) of 1993 this Court issued contempt Rule against Md. Jahangir Alam Molla, the then Presiding Officer of the court below on 11-11-93 and also directed court below to proceed with the .execution case No. 2 of 1985. He therefore, submitted that in view of the said order of this court the petitioner's application for stay before the court below was misconceived. 

 5. It appears from the impugned order that petitioner's application for stay was rejected as misconceived, petitioner not being a party in the execution proceeding he had no locus standi to file an application for stay. No relief was sought against the petitioner in the execution case. So he is not a person who will be affected by the execution of the decree. The question whether the suit property is a vested property or not cannot be decided in an execution proceeding and execution of the decree cannot affect any such right of the petitioner. 

 6. It has already been noticed that court below was proceeding with the execution case in pursuance of specific order of this Court passed on 11-11-93 in Civil Rule No. 242 (Con)/93 arising out of Civil Revision No. 2584 of 1993. Petitioner could have moved this Court for modification of that order but he could not pray for stay from the Court below which is bound by the order of this Court. In that view of the matter I find no merit in the contention raised by the learned Advocate for the petitioner.
